---
title: "Service"
---

I previously served as an Associate Editor for Criminology & Criminal Justice, Quality & Quantity, and—for a short period—The British Journal of Criminology. At the start of 2025, I decided to publish, review, and edit exclusively for diamond or similar not-for-profit open access journals. I am happy to review papers in any of my research areas for non-profit journals. Similarly, I would love to contribute to the creation of an international journal on Criminology/Criminal Justice based on Open Research practices.

In the meantime, I am a member of: the scientific committee of the [Revista Española de Investigación Criminológica](https://reic.criminologia.net/index.php/journal/about/editorialTeam); the review board of the [Journal of Legal Research Methodology](https://www.northumbriajournals.co.uk/index.php/jlrm/about/editorialTeam); the [International E-Journal of Criminal Sciences](https://ojs.ehu.eus/index.php/inecs/about/editorialTeam); and the [ESRC Peer Review College](https://www.ukri.org/councils/esrc/guidance-for-reviewers/peer-review-college/).

At the University of Leeds, I am currently the Program Leader of the [Quantitative Pathway](providing) for the BA in Criminal Justice and Criminology, I am a Co-Director of the Faculty of Social Sciences [Research Methods centre](https://socialresearchmethods.leeds.ac.uk/), I am the Director of Quantitative Research Methods at the [White Rose Doctoral Training Partnership](https://wrdtp.ac.uk/), and together with [Dr Peter Tennant](https://medicinehealth.leeds.ac.uk/medicine/staff/815/dr-peter-wg-tennant) and [Dr Roger Beecham](https://environment.leeds.ac.uk/geography/staff/1003/dr-roger-beecham), I co-lead the Leeds Institute of Data Analytics program [Science of Data Science](https://lida.leeds.ac.uk/science-of-data-science-programme/).

[![](https://img.shields.io/badge/Preprint-European%20Sourcebook-blue)](https://wp.unil.ch/europeansourcebook/printed-editions-2/7th-edition-preliminary-publication/)

I contributed to the 7th Edition of the European Sourcebook of Crime and Criminal Justice Statistics as the national correspondent for England & Wales.

### Empirical Research on Sentencing (ERoS) Network

I co-founded and co-directed (from 2017 to 2024) [ERoS](https://empiricalresearchonsentencing.wordpress.com/), a network of empirical sentencing researchers, bringing together academics and public sector researchers. During that time I co-organised four online and in-person international symposia. The network is currently led by [Dr Mojca Plesničar](https://www.inst-krim.si/en/mojca-plesnicar/), [Dr Jakub Drápal](https://www.prf.cuni.cz/en/detail-cloveka/1010944), but I still lend a hand every now and then.
